summary: Discussion-sourced signals on agent safety, vendor product deltas, operator workflows, and emerging infra projects; prioritize OpenAI security incidents, Microsoft Copilot change, Anthropic CI scaling, plus practitioner threads about agent-driven workflow shifts. | Vendor-only snapshot: major Anthropic security & model updates, Mistral product pushes, AWS storage and case study, Vercel AI SDK auth update, multiple sandbox/MCP infra signals. | GitHub OSS snapshot: vendor releases (Vercel, Anthropic, Cloudflare, mem0) plus rising infra primitives (FailproofAI observability, trycua CUA, local memory engines). No social/operator reports in this shard — many single-repo signals need corroboration before promotion. | Package-scan: mix of mainstream vendor releases (OpenAI, AWS, Amazon containers, Vercel) plus many agent infra primitives (MCP, sandbox, agent security/observability). Missing social/operator field reports for workflow signals.
